songs.title: Morning and Night 🌙
lines: In the morning, I eat breakfast,
And the sun is in the sky.
In the evening, I eat dinner,
And the moon is big and bright.
Would you like to eat lunch at night?
No, I wouldn't! Not at night!
Would you like to sleep at midnight?
Yes, I would! Good night, stars!
n: 곡조: Oh My Darling, Clementine (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
morning에서 두 팔로 해가 뜨는 원을 그리고, night·sleep에서 두 손을 모아 뺨에 대고 자는 흉내를 내요.
songs.imgPrompt: Children eating breakfast under a bright morning sun, then sleeping in bed under the moon and stars.

songs.title: What Time Is It? ⏰
lines: What time is it? Seven a.m.!
Seven a.m., seven a.m.,
I should wake up at seven
And eat breakfast on time.
What time is it? Eight a.m.!
It's eight o'clock, it's eight o'clock,
I should go to school at eight,
So I should not be late!
n: 곡조: The Muffin Man (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
두 팔을 시계 바늘처럼 움직여 7시·8시를 만들고, late에서 손목시계를 톡톡 두드려요.
songs.imgPrompt: A child waking up to an alarm clock, eating breakfast and walking to school on time in the morning.

songs.title: How Long Does It Take? ⏱️
lines: How long does it take you to eat?
It takes me twenty minutes.
How long does it take to cook dinner?
Forty minutes!
I start at two and finish at three.
How long? It takes one hour!
Does it take you five minutes?
No, it doesn't!
n: 곡조: Pop Goes the Weasel (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
How long?에서 두 손을 양옆으로 벌리고, 마지막 No, it doesn't!에서 고개를 저으며 손을 흔들어요.
songs.imgPrompt: A family cooking dinner together in a kitchen with a big clock on the wall while a child eats a meal.
